apps.name: ByeTunes
apps.subtitle: Add music to the iOS library without a computer
apps.localizedDescription: ByeTunes writes MP3, M4A, FLAC and WAV files straight into the iOS media library by talking to the media database directly, so adding a song no longer needs a cable and a desktop sync session. You can create and manage playlists in the app, and import metadata is fetched from iTunes or Deezer. The ringtone injector is disabled upstream for now, so treat ringtones as not working yet. Open source under the MIT license, with the iOS build published from the project's own GitHub releases.

ByeTunes 2.6 | ByeTunes.v2.6.-.Version.fix

# ByeTunes v2.6 – Favorites, Playlist Pinning & Background Downloads Reworked

Hi guys, here is the 2.6 update for ByeTunes. A good amount of things got added, fixed and improved in this one. You can now properly favorite injected songs, pin playlists from inside ByeTunes, and keep downloads going in the background with a new Picture in Picture window. There were also a bunch of fixes around metadata, library management and database safety.

**Favorites**

There are three new options inside Library Repair:

- **Create Favorites Playlist** creates the Favorites playlist using the right name for your device region.
- **Fix Missing Favorites** repairs songs injected with an older version that you already favorited but that never actually appeared in Favorites.
- **Delete Favorites Playlist** lets you delete that playlist from Library Repair.

Songs injected from 2.6 onwards now get their store IDs during injection, so you can favorite them right away. If the metadata fetcher finds a match, ByeTunes uses the IDs from that match. Songs without a match get generated IDs instead.

**Quick recommendation:** if you have older injected songs that you favorited but cannot find in Favorites, run **Fix Missing Favorites** inside Library Repair.

**Playlist Pinning**

You can now pin and unpin playlists from the On-Device Library. Long-press a playlist or use the Pin button from inside it.

**Keep in mind: pinning and unpinning these playlists needs to be done through ByeTunes. The Pin option inside the Apple Music app does not work for them.**

**Background Downloads**

Background downloads got a big rework. ByeTunes now uses silent audio to keep downloads going in the background, with an optional Picture in Picture window so you can see what is happening after leaving the app.

The window shows the current song's progress, what is next in the queue, and when metadata is being fetched. You can also customize it with themes, your own colors or a background picture. There is a live preview in Settings so you can see how it looks before using it.

This replaces the old background download behavior and Live Activity support. Download progress now shows in the Picture in Picture window.

If the app closes while songs are still downloading, those songs go back to the front of the queue the next time you open ByeTunes.

Pause and Cancel were fixed too. They now properly stop background transfers instead of accidentally starting a fallback download after you already paused or cancelled the song.

**Download Queue & Saving Files**

Downloaded songs now get their metadata as part of the download process. You will see a "fetching metadata" state before the song is marked as done, instead of that work being left to a separate background metadata manager.

A few other things got added or improved:

- **Clear All** for completed items in the queue sheet.
- Preview buttons in the album sheet and artist profile.
- Icons instead of text in the download queue indicator.
- Downloads are now limited to **2 at a time for MP3 and 1 for FLAC**, matching what the server supports. (This is temporal until I can pay for a better provider)
- A **server status banner** appears when the server goes into maintenance. Downloads are blocked while the server is down.
- A new **Save With Fetched Metadata** toggle that writes the fetched tags and cover artwork into the MP3 and FLAC copies you save.

**Metadata Fixes**

Metadata matching got a lot of attention in this update. There were cases where a remix could get the original song's information, or a song could get renamed to a different track from the same album. Those issues should now be fixed.

- Downloaded songs now look up the exact Deezer track and album. An Apple Music match is only accepted if it belongs to the same album.
- Apple Music track matching now checks the title, so songs should no longer get relabeled as another track from that album.
- Apple Music search pages are requested in English so ByeTunes can find the Songs and Albums sections even when using a non-English storefront.
- A Deezer result with missing artwork or an unreadable item no longer causes the entire search to come back empty.
- The broken song.link mapping was replaced with Deezer matching, and download failures now show more accurate messages.

FLAC handling was improved too. Some changes in the downloaded files were causing every song to take the album name as its title when an `ALBUMTITLE` tag was present. That is fixed now.

Album artist is also read correctly from files using the `ALBUM ARTIST` or `album_artist` tags.

**Library Management**

Added sorting, a genre filter and multi-delete to the Library management tab.

Fixed an issue where the library would only show some of your songs, for example just 50 tracks. ByeTunes was only scanning one folder. It now scans all folders so the rest of your songs show up too.

Injected songs now use the file's creation date for a more accurate date.

Deleting songs also cleans up any albums, artists and artwork entries left empty after the deletion.

**Stability, Backups & Database Safety**

There were also several fixes to make injection, transfers and backups more reliable:

- One unreadable local file no longer stops the whole injection batch.
- The export folder is checked before transferring files. If it cannot be used, ByeTunes falls back to its own Exports folder.
- Snapshot backups keep the previous snapshot until the new one finishes successfully, and only replace snapshots of the same kind.
- The heartbeat timeout handles stale connection attempts more reliably.
- Matched songs now save their real catalog ID in `match_redownload_params` instead of placeholder text.

Overall stability and database safety were improved too.

**Cleanup**

The old background metadata manager and its pending import pipeline were removed, since downloaded songs now get their metadata directly during the download process.

The Live Activity extension and download tracking were also removed as part of the move to Picture in Picture, along with the old background download behavior and unused code.

**Official Backend & Building Your Own**

I also added [BACKEND_TERMS.md](https://github.com/EduAlexxis/ByeTunes/blob/main/BACKEND_TERMS.md), which explains how the official hosted backend may be used. **Modified builds need to use their own backend.**

If you are building ByeTunes yourself, `Config.example.plist` is now included as a template for the backend address. The README explains how to set it up.

I also reorganized the project structure. Files are now grouped into proper folders so everything is easier to find and work on. This should help anyone working on their own fork of ByeTunes understand where things are and make changes more easily. I am also considering a bigger rewrite of the app down the road, so this cleanup is a step towards that, but nothing is confirmed yet.

Thanks as always to everyone testing ByeTunes, sending logs and reporting what breaks. Hope you guys enjoy this update.

compatibility.notes: Upstream documents iOS 16.0 or later. Writing into the media database is an unofficial flow: back up anything you cannot lose before mass-importing, and re-run the import after a major iOS update.

apps.name: Cosmos Music Player
apps.subtitle: Music player
apps.localizedDescription: Cosmos Music Player is a premium music player for iOS built on iCloud Drive and local storage. It gives you a clean, modern player for the music you keep on your device and in iCloud.
apps.versionDescription:
Cosmos Music Player 1.2.5 | Cosmos-Music-Player

- Search is now available across songs, favorites, artists, albums, and playlists.
- Lyrics have been redesigned with smoother synchronization, tap-to-seek, instrumental breaks, offline caching, and alternate versions.
- Added broader support for Opus, Ogg, FLAC, AAC/M4A, DSF, and DFF files.
- Improved playback stability, gapless transitions, seeking, Bluetooth, CarPlay, and audio interruption handling.
- Added appearance options: System, Light, and Dark.
- Added controls for automatic library scan frequency and artist organization.
- Added a Create Playlist button when no playlists exist.
- Improved artwork loading for iCloud and externally imported music.
- Improved Siri, widgets, CarPlay, and Share extension reliability.
- Fixed library issues involving moved, renamed, restored, or temporarily unavailable files.
- Added and improved translations across all supported languages.
- Includes numerous performance improvements and bug fixes.

apps.name: MaxMusic
apps.subtitle: YTMusicUltimate with extra tweaks
apps.localizedDescription: MaxMusic (formerly YTMUltimate+) is Mark02-2012's fork of Dayanch96's YTMusicUltimate for the YouTube Music app on iOS. It keeps everything YTMusicUltimate provides — no ads, background playback, download manager, audio quality selection — and adds Return YouTube Music Dislike, YouMusicPiP, YTMABConfig and VolumeBoostYT, plus fixed in-app downloads on newer YouTube Music versions. Settings live inside YouTube Music under Settings.

apps.name: SpotiFLAC Mobile
apps.subtitle: FLAC Downloader for iOS
apps.localizedDescription: SpotiFLAC Mobile is an open-source Spotify track and playlist metadata downloader and FLAC converter for iOS and Android. Search and download high-quality FLAC and MP3 audio with complete ID3 metadata, embedded album artwork, and synchronized lyrics directly on your device.

- **theme**: Retain dominant cover colors in player backgrounds

- **downloads**: Recover native queues when their service dies
- **verification**: Bound browser handoffs and release expired dialogs
- **player**: Size volume slider handle proportionally
- **settings**: Use shared sheet for log level selection

- **library**: Build DateFormat and RegExp once instead of per row
- **history**: Suppress unchanged membership notifications
- **history**: Reuse unchanged download lookup indexes

- **android**: Move SAF batch exists and modtime queries out of MainActivitySafScan.kt

- **convert**: Route single-track conversion through the shared pipeline

- **analysis**: Move the FFmpeg runner out of the widget

- **analysis**: Move the pure FFmpeg builders and parsers to a service
- **setup**: Move SharedPreferences access behind SetupProgressStore and SafMigrationPromptStore
- **providers**: Move UI-declared providers to lib/providers
- **rust**: Rename mod.rs modules to the foo.rs + foo/ layout
- **concerts**: Move the calendar channel into a service
- **repo**: Prepare install paths in the repo notifier
- **share**: Share the widget capture helper
- **extensions**: Share the extension health color and icon helpers
- **playlists**: Share the playlist name prompt and dispose its controller
- **artist**: Move the discography download into a part
- **home**: Use downloadSingleTrack for search results
- **storage**: Share the SAF download tree pick
- **layout**: Share responsiveScale and effectiveTextScale
- **layering**: Move logic files out of screens
- **layering**: Move model files to models and fix inverted imports
- **layering**: Move UI action helpers from services and utils to controllers
- **core**: Add fs::write_atomic and use it for the atomic file writes
- **rust**: Consolidate small duplicate helpers
- **core**: Move the lenient Go-style JSON decoder to core::json
